source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Which feature of an agent working environment is emphasized when you want help editing skill files?

options.text: A larger set of learned parameters
options.feedback: Model size is different from the working environment. The relevant distinction is whether the environment can work with your files and tools.

options.text: A more detailed written completion claim
options.feedback: A detailed claim remains a description. File-editing work depends on the environment's ability to use files and tools.
Display polish does not establish file-working capability. Choose an environment with the tools and context that fit the work.

options.text: Access to the needed files and tools
options.feedback: The demonstration distinguished a conversation-centered interaction from an agent environment that can work with files and tools.
